provenance.note: Enrolled version (79th Session, 2017), the text both houses passed (final votes on the 2nd and 3rd Reprints). Section 7 (NRS 202.360) adds the extended-protection-order bar and the stalking-finding bar, and strikes and renumbers some paragraph letters (struck text not quoted). Sections 1 and 3 also raise the penalty for violating a gun provision from a gross misdemeanor to a category B felony (struck wording not quoted). The surrender procedure (receipts, 72-hour reporting, dealer storage fees, seizure on a warrant) is in sections 2 and 5, only partly quoted. The sentences ending in a colon introduce lettered lists that are not quoted in full.
